say:10:1029417007:1.source_cn: ……什么圣，什么石？哎呀，我实在是年纪大了，耳朵不好使...

say:11:1029417008:1.text: ... But didn't you hear us earlier as clear as day? We said we're looking into THE THEFT OF THE FAITH STONE!
say:11:1029417008:1.source_cn: 耳朵不好？可是你刚刚不是听得挺清楚的吗，是圣——石——...

say:16:1029417012:1.text: Oh, come on! My hearing's been bad for a long time now. Ask anyone in Holistone, and they'll say the same thing. How can you say I'm faking it?
say:16:1029417012:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我这耳朵不好可是老毛病了，你问圣石镇的人大家都知...

say:17:1029417013:1.source_cn: 可是……这对我们很重要！因为圣石失窃的事情，牵扯到我们...

say:18:1029417014:1.source_cn: ……咳。算了，看在你们从魔偶手里守护了圣石镇的份上，我...

say:21:1029417017:0.text: That all happened so long ago... I was on my way to the bell tower that night, walking along with my lamp as usual.

say:26:1029417021:1.text: But I do remember that she was just standing next to the Faith Stone's altar. She stood there for a long time without doing anything special.

say:27:1029417022:1.text: I thought that maybe she was just in a bad mood and had come out to clear her head. I didn't really pay her much attention.
